book.name: ṮAKWIIN
book.title: Gwo ma Musa jin ’Kwara A’di jin Ta jin Ṯwa/a/ mo jin Yuḵu Gway ka Ṯakwiin

content: Ka cima kamu/ ’ko’di mii yan mo tani tap̱a jin karu mmohil ’kwani kun miina ṯu’c e gu’b ma maliḵ gi ’Kwani Masir mo dhali aman’coḵ maam piti mo tani uni thamki to mii mo gom tap̱a maliḵ Masir buni mo.
Dhala P̱irawn shwaki’da nyor gom ’kwani kun can ka askar piti su/ gwan mo, tap̱a jin karu mmohil ’kwani kun miina ṯu’c e gu’b ma maliḵ mo dhali aman’coḵ maam piti mo.
A’di dhuki uni eya sijin mo e gu’b gi wathi/ jin ca’d gom ’kwani ma mee kun jina ji eya sijin mo jin di’di bwaŋ’kwariny mo jin dikin ma Yuusup̱ nycine/ mo.
Wathi/ jin ca’d gom ’kwani ma mee kun jina ji mo tani a’di ḵanki’da Yuusup̱ gwo mo gom uni mo dhali a’di miiki uni to mo dhali uni ’kon ki mondeḵ is mo ki sule/ sule/ ntaga cima kamu/ mo.

Dhali mon’thinya kamu/ mo tani uni su/ shu’bki jan mo a’di jin ta tap̱a gom ’kwani kun miina ṯu’c mo dhali a’di jin ta’da man’coḵ maa goma maliḵ ’Kwani Masir mo uni kun ’kokin e bwaŋ’kwariny ma sijin mo uni ita gi jan buni ki she/ ki she/ mo dhali ’pemen jan buni ’kon ki she/ ki she/ mo.
Ka Yuusup̱ p̱u’dki’di uni mon’thamo/ mo tani dhali p̱arki uni e ki uni ṯocu ’kus mo.
Wakan a’di doṯki ’kwani ma mee ma P̱irawn uni kun nyaḵ ’ko ki a’di e mo jin deḵuwa deḵ mo e gu’b gi tap̱am piti mo ki: Atinta iṯaka um jis/em bum ka luŋgu’b kan ganne/ mo?

Uni ṯorki a’di gwo mo ki: Aman takina ki jan mo dhali wathi/ p̱iyi’d jin midi ṯor ’pemen buni mo. Dhala Yuusup̱ thoḵki uni gwo mo ki: Dina mo jin ṯoru ’pemen jan ki ta kuma Arumgimis mowa? Ṯori uni ki aha/ mo ma aha/ ’thona um mo.
Wakan tap̱a jin karu mmohil ’kwani ma ṯu’c ṯorki jan piti ka Yuusup̱ mo dhali a’di oki a’di gwo mo ki: E jan pem mo tani cwalmana mura’th uni ’kokini bwambori aha/ mo.
Dhali ap̱o/ cwalmana mura’th mo tani abi karkini kwara e a’di mo dhali me’d jin lu/kina a’di mo tani jandim piti c̱a’bki’d ki ṯup̱ ṯup̱ mo dhali atora mura’th iski’d mo jin minu ’ciṯẖ mo.
Aḵubbaaya ma P̱irawn diki’d e me’d pem mo dhali aha/ bu’thkina amura’th mo dhali nyu/ uni e bwam ma ḵubbaaya ma P̱irawn mo dhali karka/ aḵubbaaya e me’d ma P̱irawn mo.
Dhala Yuusup̱ thoḵki a’di gwo mo ki: ’Pemen jan a’dan be: cwalman ma mura’th kun ’koni kwara mo tani a’di ita’da cimi kwara mo.

E bwaman ma cimi kwara yan mo tani aP̱irawn midi ’de’k ’kup̱ pini ki mis mo dhali wari /e is mo mmodoḵa ṯu’c pini ka nyaŋ’ko’d mo dhali /e mini dhuwa P̱irawn aḵubbaaya e me’d piti mo me’d jan dhamo/ mo me’d jin karkunu /e mmota tap̱a gom ’kwani kun miina ṯu’c mo.

Hili /e mini mii kayaa/ e mo ki mii midi mii ha me’d mo gom /e mo dhali miiyi aha/ ki mii gi bwaŋkush mo, aha/ ’thona /e mo jin mina /e mii pika P̱irawn gwo yan i is gom aha/ mo dhali wakan /e mini ’cuḵaa/ ka pije/ ’peni gu’b yan mo.
Haali/ aha/ ka jiŋ gana/ ḵwalkunu mo ’peni Paŋ ’Kwani Ibraan mo dhali e mahan si’da/ mo tani aha/ dinaki mii toŋ kamu/ mo jin mina uni kar aha/ e jisa ’tum yan mo.

Ki tap̱a jin ta’da man’coḵ maa mo p̱arki ’pemen jan yan e ki uni ha me’d mo tani a’di oki’da Yuusup̱ gwo mo ki: Aha/ si’da/ tana gi jan mo. Maaŋḵuthu’d kun ḵalka/ ka nura/ ikwara mo tani uni ’koni ’kup̱i aha/ mo.
Dhali e ’kup̱an ma nura/ mo tani aris maaŋḵuthu’d tana eya ris ka ris mo goma P̱irawn mo hili aris ’dii ’kokin mo mmoshwa uni mo ’peni bwam ma nura/ e ’kup̱i aha/ mo be.
Dhala Yuusup̱ thoḵki a’di gwo mo ki: ’Pemen jan a’dan be: anura/ kun ’koni kwara mo tani a’di ita’da cimi kwara mo.
E bwaman ma cimi kwara yan mo tani P̱irawn midi ’de’k ’kup̱ pini ki mis mo ’peni /e mo dhali /e minu shir ka ’cajala/ ap̱o/ cwa mo dhali aris ’dii mini ’ka shum gi buŋgwar is ’peni /e mo.

Ka cimi kwara a’di jin ta’da cim jin dhodhuwa P̱irawn mo tani a’di yuḵki’da yuḵ jin yuḵu ’kwani mmotul ’kup̱ mo goma ris ’kwanim piti kun miina ṯu’c mo dhali a’di ’de’kki ’kup̱ gi wathi/ jin ta tap̱a gom ’kwani ma ṯu’c gi gu’b ma maliḵ mo dhali ’kup̱ gi wathi/ jin ta’da man’coḵ maa mo e bwaman ’kwanim piti kun miina ṯu’c mo.
A’di warki wathi/ jin ta tap̱a jin karu mmohil ’kwani ma ṯu’c gi gu’b ma maliḵ is mo dhali a’di karki’da ḵubbaaya e me’d ma P̱irawn mo.
Hili a’di shirki tap̱a jin ta’da man’coḵ maa ’kus ka shi/ mo me’d ’pemen jan jin ṯorkin ma Yuusup̱ uni mo.
Dhali wathi/ jin karu mmohil ’kwani kun miina ṯu’c e gu’b ma maliḵ mac̱a/ ya’di ka aYuusup̱ e mo yisa hili a’di thiski a’di e mo be.
